lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Void Entity-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Young Shadow Fragment I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shadow Fragment I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Shadow Fragment Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Shadow Fragment I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Torn Shadow Fragment I
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Shadow Fragment I bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Branded Shadow Fragment I
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Shadow Fragment I — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Shadow Fragment I is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_6.name: Shadow Fragment I the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Shadow Fragment I now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Shadow Fragment Is have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_7.name: Primordial Shadow Fragment I
star_7.appearance: The final form. Shadow Fragment I stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Shadow Fragment I is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Warped Hermit Senior — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Warped Hermit Senior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Warped Hermit Senior the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Warped Hermit Senior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Warped Hermit Seniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Young Dark Tendril Feral
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dark Tendril Feral. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Dark Tendril Ferals in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Dark Tendril Feral

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Pup Night Cultist Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Night Cultist Ancient. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Night Cultist Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Night Cultist Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Night Cultist Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Night Cultist Ancient bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Ascendant Night Cultist Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Night Cultist Ancient — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Night Cultist Ancient is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

star_6.name: Night Cultist Ancient the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Night Cultist Ancient now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Night Cultist Ancients have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_7.name: Primordial Night Cultist Ancient
star_7.appearance: The final form. Night Cultist Ancient stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Night Cultist Ancient is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Nemesis Gug Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nemesis Gug Alpha. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Nemesis Gug Alphas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: First-Form Nemesis Gug Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Nemesis Gug Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Nemesis Gug Alpha bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Exalted Nemesis Gug Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Fledgling Swamp Eldritch Spawn IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Swamp Eldritch Spawn IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Swamp Eldritch Spawn IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Swamp Eldritch Spawn IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.name: Pup Eldritch Spawn IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Eldritch Spawn IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Eldritch Spawn IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Emerging Eldritch Spawn IV

base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Lesser Nightmare Spawn III
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nightmare Spawn III. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Nightmare Spawn IIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Nightmare Spawn III
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Pup Lightning Moon Beast Trader
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Lightning Moon Beast Trader. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Lightning Moon Beast Traders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Lightning Moon Beast Trader
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Lightning Moon Beast Trader bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Crowned Lightning Moon Beast Trader

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.name: Awakened Omega Yog-Sothoth Omega Gate

base_chain.name: Pup Marsh Star Gazer

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Marsh Star Gazers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Marsh Star Gazer

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

star_6.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_7.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Arachnid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Newborn Wandering Void Crawler Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Wandering Void Crawler Ancient. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Wandering Void Crawler Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Stirring Wandering Void Crawler Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Wandering Void Crawler Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Wandering Void Crawler Ancient bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Fledgling Death Flying Polyp Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Death Flying Polyp Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Death Flying Polyp Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Death Flying Polyp Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Spawn Hallowed Cthonian Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hallowed Cthonian Elder. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Hallowed Cthonian Elders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Hallowed Cthonian Elder
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Hallowed Cthonian Elder
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Hallowed Cthonian Elder bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Ascendant Hallowed Cthonian Elder
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Hallowed Cthonian Elder — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Hallowed Cthonian Elder is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Hallowed Cthonian Elder Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Hallowed Cthonian Elder now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Hallowed Cthonian Elders have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_7.name: Eternal Hallowed Cthonian Elder
star_7.appearance: The final form. Hallowed Cthonian Elder stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Hallowed Cthonian Elder is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Complete "The Silence Beyond Stars" story quest

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Newborn Rune Hunting Horror
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rune Hunting Horror. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Rune Hunting Horrors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Rune Hunting Horror
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Rune Hunting Horror
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Rune Hunting Horror bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Marked Rune Hunting Horror

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Spawn Cursed Chthonian Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cursed Chthonian Juvenile. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Cursed Chthonian Juveniles in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Cursed Chthonian Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Cursed Chthonian Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Cursed Chthonian Juvenile bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Ascendant Cursed Chthonian Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Bud Archon Star Spawn Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Archon Star Spawn Elder. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Archon Star Spawn Elders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Archon Star Spawn Elder
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Awakened Sacred Formless Spawn

base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Blazing Mi-Go Surgeons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Marked Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Blazing Mi-Go Surgeons have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_7.name: Legend Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon
star_7.appearance: The final form. Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Blazing Mi-Go Surgeon is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Dust Eldritch Fragment Ancient — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Dust Eldritch Fragment Ancient is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Dust Eldritch Fragment Ancient the Last
star_6.appearance: Dust Eldritch Fragment Ancient now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Dust Eldritch Fragment Ancients have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Crag Mad Preacher II
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crag Mad Preacher II. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Crag Mad Preacher IIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Crag Mad Preacher II
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Crag Mad Preacher II
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Crag Mad Preacher II bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Young Void Wisp Omega
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Void Wisp Omega. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Void Wisp Omegas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Void Wisp Omega

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Lesser Small Warped Hermit Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Small Warped Hermit Corrupted. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Small Warped Hermit Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Small Warped Hermit Corrupted

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Wisp Tcho-Tcho Cultist Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Tcho-Tcho Cultist Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Tcho-Tcho Cultist Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Tcho-Tcho Cultist Senior

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Dread Shoggoth Fragment the Revered
star_6.appearance: Dread Shoggoth Fragment now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Dread Shoggoth Fragments have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_7.name: Apex Dread Shoggoth Fragment

base_chain.name: Newborn Dream Fragment

tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Dream Stalker Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dream Stalker Awakened. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Dream Stalker Awakeneds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Stirring Dream Stalker Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Dream Stalker Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Dream Stalker Awakened bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Chosen Dream Stalker Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Dream Stalker Awakened — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Dream Stalker Awakened is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Dream Stalker Awakened the Last
star_6.appearance: Dream Stalker Awakened now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Dream Stalker Awakeneds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_7.name: Final Dream Stalker Awakened
star_7.appearance: The final form. Dream Stalker Awakened stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Dream Stalker Awakened is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Complete "The Silence Beyond Stars" story quest

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Lesser Nightmare Chthonian Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nightmare Chthonian Juvenile. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Nightmare Chthonian Juveniles in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Nightmare Chthonian Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Void Shard

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Newborn Bone Cultist Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Bone Cultist Prime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Bone Cultist Primes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Bone Cultist Prime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Stellar Being-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Cosmic Fragment Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cosmic Fragment Ancient. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Cosmic Fragment Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Cosmic Fragment Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Newborn Sinuous Byakhee Rider Corrupted

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Murk Dark Stalker — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Murk Dark Stalker is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Murk Dark Stalker Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Murk Dark Stalker now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Murk Dark Stalkers have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_7.name: God-King Murk Dark Stalker
star_7.appearance: The final form. Murk Dark Stalker stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Murk Dark Stalker is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Young Warped Hermit
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Warped Hermit. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Warped Hermits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Lightning Dimensional Shambler
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Lightning Dimensional Shambler. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Lightning Dimensional Shamblers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Lightning Dimensional Shambler
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Lightning Dimensional Shambler
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Lightning Dimensional Shambler bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Marked Lightning Dimensional Shambler
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Lightning Dimensional Shambler — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Lightning Dimensional Shambler is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Lightning Dimensional Shambler Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Lightning Dimensional Shambler now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Lightning Dimensional Shamblers have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_7.name: Legend Lightning Dimensional Shambler
star_7.appearance: The final form. Lightning Dimensional Shambler stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Lightning Dimensional Shambler is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Pup Silver Flying Polyp Scout

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Silver Flying Polyp Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling Silver Flying Polyp Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Fledgling Threadbare Shadow Fragment IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Threadbare Shadow Fragment IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Threadbare Shadow Fragment IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rising Threadbare Shadow Fragment IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

star_6.name: Jade Hound of Tindalos the Feared

star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Newborn Apex Star Spawn Elder

base_chain.name: First-Form Apex Star Spawn Elder
