base_chain.name: Hatchling Sunken Night Spawn
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sunken Night Spawn. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Sunken Night Spawns in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Sunken Night Spawn

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Young Necrotic Hound of Tindalos
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Necrotic Hound of Tindalos. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Necrotic Hound of Tindaloss in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Necrotic Hound of Tindalos
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Necrotic Hound of Tindalos
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Necrotic Hound of Tindalos bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Pup Supreme Nightgaunt Elder

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Supreme Nightgaunt Elders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Supreme Nightgaunt Elder
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Wisp Nightmare Stalker
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nightmare Stalker. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Nightmare Stalkers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Nightmare Stalker
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Nightmare Stalker
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Nightmare Stalker bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Exalted Nightmare Stalker
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Dream Spawns in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Emerging Dream Spawn
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Salt Dream Spawn
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Dream Spawn bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Ascendant Dream Spawn
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Dream Spawn — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Dream Spawn is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Dream Spawn the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Dream Spawn now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Dream Spawns have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_7.name: Primordial Dream Spawn
star_7.appearance: The final form. Dream Spawn stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Dream Spawn is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Waning Fire Vampire Corrupted Transcendent

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Pup Malevolent Great Race of Yith
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Malevolent Great Race of Yith. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Malevolent Great Race of Yiths in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Malevolent Great Race of Yith
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Void — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of The Outer Dark. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Infernal Dark Young Spawn
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Infernal Dark Young Spawn bears the aesthetic of The Outer Dark — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Void crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Crowned Infernal Dark Young Spawn
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. The Outer Dark-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Cosmic Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In The Outer Dark, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Infernal Dark Young Spawn — Cosmic Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Cosmic path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Cosmic Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Infernal Dark Young Spawn is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of The Outer Dark. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: Infernal Dark Young Spawn Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Infernal Dark Young Spawn now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Infernal Dark Young Spawns have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_7.name: Eternal Infernal Dark Young Spawn
star_7.appearance: The final form. Infernal Dark Young Spawn stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Infernal Dark Young Spawn is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Silence Beyond Stars" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

lore_summary: A creature of the The Outer Dark, aligned with Void energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of The Outer Dark. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Void tamers are called Watchers. The bond is formed in silence — the monster chooses the tamer, never the reverse.

base_chain.name: Pup Mad Preacher Lesser
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Mad Preacher Lesser. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of The Outer Dark. Mad Preacher Lessers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%
